{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Weight each nonpadding target by 0.95 raised to the number of later nonpadding targets, emphasizing recent prefixes while retaining the existing pairwise-plus-0.2-pointwise objective across all four datasets. Architecture and predictor shapes remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)","replace":"    loss = pairwise_loss + 0.2 * pointwise_loss
    later_targets = mask.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) - mask.cumsum(dim=1)
    weights = mask * mask.new_tensor(0.95).pow(later_targets)
    return (loss * weights).sum() / weights.sum().clamp(min=1.0)"},{"find":"DATA_DIR = os.environ.get("GAGC_DATA_DIR", "./input/trainval")","replace":"DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']"}]}],"change_summary":"Apply recency-weighted loss normalization to all four category models and enforce the required DATA_DIR environment lookup. Preserve GRU topology, sampling, optimizer, training settings and inference."}
